recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not restore evidence-quality/preferred in core unless CDS explicitly reverses the later Evidence certainty and EBMonFHIR terminology-binding decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-28134 was a Published/Persuasive CDS technical correction for R5 asking Evidence.certainty.rating's EvidenceCertaintyRating binding to use http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/evidence-quality with Preferred strength instead of a separate four-code certainty-rating list.
initial_application: Commit 34ac676510 changed the then-authoritative Evidence spreadsheet row from code list/extensible #certainty-rating to value set/preferred http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/evidence-quality. Follow-up commits 35167980e3 and cefed7e614 adjusted related Evidence examples, with cefed7e614 correcting instance codings to the CodeSystem URL.
additional_context: FHIR-28920 later reworked Evidence.certainty for R5 and specified EvidenceCertaintyRating as a broader certainty-rating value set. The v5.0.0 source uses http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/certainty-rating. FHIR-39632 and UP-396 moved and completed this terminology in THO, and FHIR-53156 later changed the Evidence certainty binding family to Example strength with EBMonFHIR IG guidance.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current build-scope source/fhir.ini includes Evidence, and source/evidence/structuredefinition-Evidence.xml binds Evidence.certainty.rating to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/certainty-rating with Example strength, matching later CDS decisions and current examples.

related_jiras.note: Superseded the narrower evidence-quality/preferred binding by redefining EvidenceCertaintyRating as a broader certainty-rating value set for the recursive Evidence.certainty model.
Moved certainty-related code system definitions out of core and toward THO references.
Added the extra certainty-rating codes to THO so the broader value set could live outside core.
Changed Evidence certainty terminology bindings, including StatisticCertaintyRating/EvidenceCertaintyRating, to Example strength with EBMonFHIR IG guidance.
